# Phillips

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolmaster at Avonlea school  <sub>[v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mr. Phillips  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>; Master  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P58](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0058)</sub>

## Appearance

Mr. Phillips is known for curling his mustache while teaching.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)_

## Personality

Mr. Phillips is a sarcastic and hypocritical teacher who carries out his duties with a high hand. He displays little imagination and lacks discipline, keeping scandalous order in his classroom. He frequently neglects the younger pupils to spend his time flirting with the older girls, particularly Prissy Andrews. He is also quick to punish unfairly, using pupils as scapegoats for his own fits of temper.

_Sources: [v1 c11 P33](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0033), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P60](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0060), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## History

Mr. Phillips served as the schoolmaster at Avonlea school, where he notoriously paid more attention to his grown-up sixteen-year-old student, Prissy Andrews, than to his educational duties. During his tenure, he humiliated Anne Shirley on several occasions, such as holding up her slate with spelling errors, forcing her to stand on the platform under a blackboard inscription mocking her temper after she broke her slate over Gilbert Blythe's head, and making her sit beside Gilbert as a punishment for being late. Following a period of stubborn resistance, Anne refused to attend his school for weeks until he unfairly punished her again. During the winter, he took part in the Avonlea Debating Club's grand concert by reciting Mark Antony's oration over the body of Caesar. At the end of June, his engagement at Avonlea school ended, and he gave an affecting farewell speech to his pupils before leaving the settlement permanently.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P73](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0073), [v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c21 P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c28 P9](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0009)_

## Background by volume

- Boarded at Eben Wright's house while teaching in Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056)</sub>
- Secured the Avonlea school position through his uncle, who was a school trustee  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- Political affiliation as a Grit  <sub>[v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010)</sub>
